text.p: Programme of matches in the French first division on Tuesday and Wednesday (standings in parentheses, all kickoff times GMT):
Relegation battlers Caen could benefit from Montpellier's loss of form in double setback of defeat in French Cup semifinals followed by end of 12-game unbeaten run in league at Strasbourg.

Monaco, looking for elusive points to sew up championship, face buoyant League Cup winners who romped to 4-1 win at Montpellier with four goals from Pascal Nouma on Saturday. Victor Ikpeba has raced back from weekend World Cup duty with Nigeria to play for leaders, but central defender Martin Djetou is out with injury.
Corsicans dropped one place with defeat at Lyon where Pole Piotr Swierczewski was sent off for fighting. Le Havre will be battling to stay clear of relegation zone.

Metz continue desperate chase for UEFA Cup berth after crucial home win over Auxerre. Rennes, who have won 10 of their 16 home games, are six points clear of nearest relegation spot but can not afford to feel entirely safe.
Lyon have won five of last six matches but have probably left it too late to snatch place in Europe although Nice, their minds on French Cup Final, look easy meat after going down 5-0 at PSG.
Defending champions must win as chances of missing out on Europe increased with 1-0 loss at Metz. Guingamp, with sights set on May 10 French Cup Final, lost at home to lowly Nancy.

Lille, who have plummeted deep into relegation mire with five defeats in row, face rampant PSG who put five goals past Nice but will be without Leonardo, on international duty with Brazil, and suspended defender Laurent Fournier.
Lens have climbed out of relegation zone with five-game unbeaten run including three victories. Bordeaux, chasing place in Europe, won 4-3 when sides met at Lens in November.
After creditable draw at Monaco, Marseille looking to improve on 0-0 draw at Cannes in November. Jerome Alonzo continues to deputise for Germany's Andreas Koepke in goal.
Nantes, who scraped 1-1 draw at home to lowly Caen, will be wary of another side desperate to avoid relegation as they seek to extend unbeaten run to 28 matches.
